summary: In the VM installer inventory, the inventory hostname is the instance name shown in the app (useful for DR with /etc/hosts), ansible_host is how the installer reaches the host, and routable_hostname is the name receptor peers resolve to connect to the node.
questions: What is routable_hostname in the controller inventory?
What is the difference between ansible_host and routable_hostname?
How do I restore a cluster to hosts with different IPs?
